moments_per_day.source: Bentley et al. 2018, IMWUT 2(3) Art. 91, Table 6, medium-user cluster (34 of 88 homes, the largest): 2.36 sessions/day, 5.55 commands/day. Household size did not significantly change use (r² = 0.04, p = 0.74), so a family gets no extra volume
moments_per_day.note: Picking the medium cluster is part of the scenario. Sessions and commands bound the range. A companion robot could fall outside it

weekend.source: Bentley et al. 2018, IMWUT 2(3) Art. 91, p.14: homes of 3 or more gave 38.0% of commands on weekends
weekend.note: Command share used as the moment share

novelty.peak.source: Cagiltay et al. 2022 (IDC), Misty II, 14 homes
novelty.peak.note: Only measured magnitude: weekly use fell about 2.2x from week 1 to week 4 (Table 1, converting 'once a week'=1, 'a few times'=3, 'daily'=7). The conversion is an interpretation and the robot was a children's reading tutor, so the range is kept wide and swept

novelty.days.source: Weiss et al. 2021 (RO-MAN, Anki Vector): attachment dropped after 2 weeks · Bajones et al. 2019: novelty passed by 3 weeks · Cagiltay et al. 2022: still declining in week 4

long_term.floor.source: Zhao & McEwen 2025 (Luka, 19 families): use 'low but stable' by years 3 to 4
long_term.floor.note: Family recall, no logs and no number. Range kept wide and swept

long_term.from_day.source: Zhao & McEwen 2025: 'sharp drop after the first year' (recall)

long_term.to_day.source: Zhao & McEwen 2025: low and stable 'by years 3 to 4' (recall)

mix.source: Defines this household. No study measures how often people wave at, praise or insult a companion robot
mix.note: Results are conditional: 'in a home where moments look like this'. Only the proportions matter. Replace with real playtest proportions after week 10

taste.source: Defines this household. No study measures which robot responses a home warms to, or how often people praise or correct a companion robot's choices
taste.note: Results are conditional: 'in a home with this taste'. These reactions are extra events on top of the mix. Replace with logged reactions from the week 10 playtest

keeper.source: Defines this household's keeper. No study gives desk-gesture norms on Quest hand tracking (as far as we found)
keeper.note: Numbers are in the habits wear's units (m/s, m, share, s, degrees). Replace with real measured keepers after a hand-tracking check
